ValidationRule.description: If Credit Evaluation Result = Accept and Approved Requested Card Type = ila switch and Approved Transfer Type is Blank.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $User.LastName <> "Integration", ISPICKVAL( Type , "Credit Card Application"), ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type__c, "New Credit Card"), ISPICKVAL(Region_Flag__c, "Bahrain"), OR( ISPICKVAL(cc_Approved_Requested_Card_Type__c, "PLATINUM_BALANCE_TRANSFER_01"), Is_Balance_Transfer__c = true ), ISPICKVAL(cc_Approved_Transfer_Type__c, ""), OR( AND( ISCHANGED(cc_Credit_Evaluation_Result__c), ISPICKVAL(cc_Credit_Evaluation_Result__c, "Accept") ), AND( ISCHANGED(cc_HR_Result__c), ISPICKVAL(cc_HR_Result__c,'Approved') )))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill the Approver Transfer Type field for Ila Switch/ Gulf Balance Transfer Cards.
